final: WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic, AVG(CAST(HGB AS REAL)/NULLIF(HCT,0)) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), g AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS g_ratio FROM p WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS avg_of_avg_pic, AVG(p.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - g.g_ratio) AS avg_excess FROM p, g WHERE p.ratio > g.g_ratio
